verdict: advisory: no high doubts; 1 medium, 3 low — all addressed

doubts.claim_under_doubt: The signature card truthfully reports what is saved
doubts.disproof_attempt: SignaturePad set the preview before onSave; a refused localStorage write (large PNG, quota) left the card saying 'Gespeicherte Unterschrift' while nothing was stored and the status still listed Unterschrift as missing.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Store first, show preview only on success, report failure.
doubts.disposition: fixed: store() calls onSave first, shows a destructive 'Unterschrift nicht gespeichert' toast on failure and keeps the empty state; unit test added

doubts.claim_under_doubt: The settings page shows a consistent picture of the stored settings
doubts.disproof_attempt: Status box follows other tabs live while form fields keep their initial values; saving overwrites the other tab's values (pre-existing).
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Document or refresh the form on cross-tab changes.
doubts.disposition: accepted: documented in Known Limitations (multi-tab editing unlikely; overwrite behaviour unchanged)

doubts.claim_under_doubt: updateSettings merging onto the raw stored record is safe for any stored value
doubts.disproof_attempt: Valid non-object JSON would be spread into junk keys and persisted.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: readStored returns {} unless a plain object.
doubts.disposition: fixed with unit test (strings, arrays, numbers, null)

doubts.claim_under_doubt: useSetupStatus is cheap to call on every render
doubts.disproof_attempt: Each render still reads and compares the raw stored string (includes signature data URL).
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Accept with note or cache raw in memory.
doubts.disposition: accepted: a synchronous getItem plus string compare of tens of KB per keystroke is negligible; parsing is cached; reading storage keeps the hook correct without events
